acceptance_evidence: Actual local SDK and two attached clients to a real daemon preserve exact new/old/legacy IDs and source objects across ranked history, direct, compact and batch reads; default ranked query still omits superseded row. Same stored timestamps/lifecycle/successor metadata across every view; legacy unknown remains readable.

Pure projector test covers hot/cold, compact, expired/superseded lifecycle and missing peer. Exact entity/graph snapshots plus data.mdb/writer.lock bytes and inode are unchanged. No backend or model source fetch in projector.

Signed-floor epoch boundary tests cover ±1ns, ±999999ns, ±1000000ns, ±1000001ns and longer fractional durations. Overflow construction was possible and null/unrepresentable checks passed on this macOS runner. All six clocks tested independently; absent/partial clocks do not fabricate source observations.

All eight reason labels preserve numeric discriminants. RPC fixture has 30 enriched edges, one blank lifecycle edge, one excluded blank similarity and one indexed self-loop; ranked output has 32 distinct eligible edges, 12 delivered, more=true, and exact IDs/labels. Direct get preserves existing 34-adjacency-entry pagination. Missing peer remains error.

Public owner/attachment/readiness/health/Graph/writer/legacy/bounded-projection regressions passed. Only3 product files changed, with no persisted field/variant/layout change or transport/resolver/hot-reload export change.
limitations: Process/socket and file-inode assertions ran on macOS. Overflow fixture reports a platform limitation if SystemTime cannot construct a value outside signed-millisecond range; pre-epoch/fractional tests remain unconditional.
Recorded freshness means at least one creation/update clock is known; it is not remote-source recency or model truth. Source observation time is explicitly unknown.

Direct edge pagination retains prior adjacency behavior, including duplicate self-loop adjacency entries. New ranked eligible count deduplicates exact edge IDs. Cold direct metadata does not invent unavailable graph edges.
Existing query access telemetry can mutate under its owning writer; pure rendering is independently verified to preserve bytes. No persistent migration or data rewrite is required.
